records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.usage_bar.UsageBar.set_value#1
records.source: The new value is scheduled for the next paint rather than painted now. ``QProgressBar.setValue`` repaints synchronously whenever the change moves a pixel, and the bar is translucent over the window's field, so each call painted the field under it and flushed the window there and then: four synchronous flushes every two seconds on every module screen, which on a composited GPU desktop each wait for the display. With updates held off for the call, the bar is marked dirty instead and is drawn with the next field frame.
records.context: The new value is scheduled for the next paint rather than painted now. ``QProgressBar.setValue`` repaints synchronously whenever the change moves a pixel, and the bar is translucent over the window's field, so each call painted the field under it and flushed the window there and then: four synchronous flushes every two seconds on every module application view, which on a composited GPU desktop each wait for the display. With updates held off for the call, the bar is marked dirty instead and is drawn with the next field frame.
records.translation: La nouvelle valeur est planifiée pour la prochaine peinture au lieu d’être peinte maintenant. ``QProgressBar.setValue`` repeint de façon synchrone dès que le changement déplace un pixel, et la barre est translucide sur le champ de la fenêtre, si bien que chaque appel peignait le champ en dessous et vidait la fenêtre sur-le-champ : quatre vidages synchrones toutes les deux secondes sur chaque écran de module, qui sur un bureau GPU composité attendent chacun l’affichage. Avec les mises à jour suspendues pendant l’appel, la barre est marquée comme sale et dessinée avec la prochaine image du champ.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.usage_bar.UsageBar.set_value#2
records.source: The bar is re-polished only when the reading crosses into another band. A polish re-resolves the application style sheet for the bar, and the usage poll calls this for every bar every two seconds, almost always with the colour unchanged.
records.context: The bar is re-polished only when the reading crosses into another band. A polish re-resolves the application style sheet for the bar, and the usage poll calls this for every bar every two seconds, almost always with the colour unchanged.
records.translation: La barre n’est repolie que lorsque la lecture passe dans une autre bande. Un polissage résout de nouveau la feuille de style de l’application pour la barre, et l’interrogation de l’utilisation appelle ceci pour chaque barre toutes les deux secondes, presque toujours avec la couleur inchangée.
